title: Statements, transaction history and evidence-backed presentation
workflow: Authenticate requester and authorization to the account
Select approved statement period and ledger snapshot
Retrieve only posted and authorized entries with source references
Show original and reversing adjustments as distinct transactions
Reconcile opening, entries and closing totals
Render consistent accessible PDF/CSV/API export with audit reference
invariants: Statement history cannot be invented from UI cache
Reversal history must not overwrite original entry
Debit/credit labels match bank-approved accounting semantics
No cross-account information from another institution
Currency and value-date distinctions are explicit
Pending transfers are labeled separately from posted activity
planned_tests: Closing equals opening plus net posted movements
Interrupted export cannot fabricate partial totals
approval_gate: Approved statement format, finance/legal disclosures, ledger evidence and export security tests.
